mobileSimulation.limitations: Synthetic rendering of captured HTML with images/network blocked. Mobile uses a viewport and CPU throttle, not physical hardware. Compact links omit production price/badge/accessibility details and have no measured Shopify render time.

baselineFunctionalTests.scope: Existing implementation and real compiled theme search classes with synthetic responses, not the future implementation

decision: Do not inject the full results section into the preview. Share retrieval rules while rendering a dedicated compact product section.
experienceRequirements: Keep existing 300ms debounce rather than adding delay
Use one product request per settled query
Resolve technical attributes from a small cached catalog dictionary, never scan catalog while typing
Abort superseded requests and verify query revision before painting
Keep Enter independent from preview completion
Preserve input value, focus, visible options and mobile compact layout
Keep the number of images bounded and correctly sized
Separate empty matches from network errors; do not display another measure as an exact match
remainingValidation: Actual compact Liquid section server render time
End-to-end paint and input response on representative mobile network/hardware
Screen-reader and keyboard behavior of the final renderer
Uncached new queries and sustained traffic behavior
notes: Initial raw-HTTPS benchmark was excluded because it did not follow the canonical redirect. Valid comparison uses the canonical www hostname with warmup and paced requests.
Measurements are exploratory from this workstation, with reused connections and potentially warm server caches.
